name: approval-gate-enforcement
question: Can any work order reach an execution state (>= dispatched) without a prior owner-authored `approved` event? Probe A proves from work_order.rs that `Approved` is the SOLE predecessor of `Dispatched` and that is_execution_state classifies the execution set correctly. Probe B (activates when the handler lands) asserts the transition handler consults has_approved_event. Probe C (--full, activates when the test lands) runs tests/work_order_state_machine.rs.

output.schema: PASS or FAIL <n> with probe-level offender detail. Exit 0 on PASS, 1 on FAIL, 2 on environment failure. Probe B/C report PENDING (not failure) until Worker A's handler + integration test land.

consultation.typical_sessions_using: every-commit touching the work-order state machine, handler, or ledger

consumer_scope: feedbackmonk: Worker A (primary) + every reviewer touching crates/feedbackmonk-core/src/work_order.rs (state machine), crates/feedbackmonk-api/src/handlers/work_orders.rs (transition handler), or the work_order_events ledger. A green oracle with Probe B+C ACTIVE is Worker A's Stage 1 exit gate.
fallback: Probe A: read crates/feedbackmonk-core/src/work_order.rs and confirm (1) is_execution_state matches exactly {dispatched,claimed,building,verifying,reported,completed,failed} and excludes {draft,approved,cancelled}; (2) in legal_transitions_from, ONLY `Approved` lists `Dispatched` as a legal target. Probe B: read crates/feedbackmonk-api/src/handlers/work_orders.rs and confirm the transition handler calls has_approved_event before any execution-state transition. Probe C: cargo test -p feedbackmonk-api --test work_order_state_machine.

provenance.authored_by: P5a Stage 0 (Task Zero scaffold) — finalized by Worker A as the state machine + handler land
provenance.rationale: Testability Gate Flag 1 (the highest plan-wide fidelity risk, Q2=5): the work-order approval gate is THE security boundary between public internet input and code execution (FR-FBR-25a). A happy-path unit test confirms `approve -> approved` but cannot prove the ABSENCE of bypass code paths; an execution-state row with no `approved` event is a remote-code-execution path from public feedback. This oracle is detection-from-STATE (state-machine source + handler + ledger), the anti-reward-hacking leg per Contract C22 invariant 1 — it cannot be satisfied by a self-reported flag. Scaffolded in Stage 0 (Probe A live; B/C co-evolve with Worker A); a green oracle is Worker A's exit gate.
